flows.name: User Login
flows.trigger: User clicks BTN_LOGIN on HRMS_LOGIN form

steps.action: authenticate(p_username, p_password) → INSERT USER_SESSIONS, returns session_id
check_session → PKG_SECURITY.is_session_valid on every navigation (30-min timeout from LOGIN_TIME)

known_issues: No brute-force protection in PKG_SECURITY.authenticate
TOO_MANY_ROWS exception handler picks lowest EMP_ID — could authenticate wrong user
Password validation is a stub — no hash comparison against stored credential
Session timeout based on LOGIN_TIME not last activity

flows.name: Hire New Employee
flows.trigger: HR administrator fills employee form and clicks Save (new record)

steps.action: create_employee(p_first_name, p_last_name, p_dept_id, p_job_id, p_hire_date, p_salary, ...)
generate_emp_number() — SELECT MAX + 1 (race condition; no SELECT FOR UPDATE)
TRG_EMPLOYEES_VALIDATE BEFORE INSERT — validates HIRE_DATE ≤ SYSDATE+180, salary ≥ JOB_GRADES.MIN_SALARY
create_salary_record(emp_id, salary, ...) — end-dates any prior ACTIVE record, inserts new
initialize leave balances (via PKG_LEAVE or direct INSERT — exact mechanism unknown)

known_issues: Form validates 90-day future limit; DB trigger allows 180 days — inconsistency
generate_emp_number has race condition under concurrent inserts
PKG_EMPLOYEE → PKG_PAYROLL call creates circular dependency (CYCLE-01)

flows.name: Terminate Employee
flows.trigger: HR administrator clicks Terminate on HRMS_EMPLOYEE form

steps.action: UPDATE EMPLOYEES SET EMPLOYMENT_STATUS='TERMINATED', ACTIVE_FLAG='N', TERMINATION_DATE, TERMINATION_REASON
Cancels all PENDING leave requests for emp_id
Sets all active EMPLOYEE_PAY_ELEMENTS to inactive

known_issues: TODO comment in code: COBRA benefits notification not implemented
TODO: system access revocation not implemented
TODO: final pay calculation not implemented
TRG_EMPLOYEES_VALIDATE prevents ACTIVE_FLAG changes to terminated employees; rehire_employee is the only valid reactivation path

flows.name: Payroll Calculation Run
flows.trigger: Payroll administrator clicks Calculate on HRMS_PAYROLL form

steps.action: OPEN cursor FOR all ACTIVE employees in run
LOOP per employee: calculate_federal_tax(gross_pay, filing_status) — HARD-CODED 2024 brackets
LOOP per employee: calculate_state_tax(gross_pay, state_code) — simplified flat rates
LOOP per employee: calculate_fica(gross_pay, ytd_ss_wages) — $168,600 wage base hard-coded
UPDATE PAYROLL_RUNS SET STATUS='CALCULATED', total amounts

known_issues: Partial COMMIT every 50 rows — failure leaves run in half-calculated state with no rollback path
Row-by-row cursor processing — documented in code as needing refactor to BULK COLLECT
Tax brackets and FICA wage base are hard-coded 2024 values — must be updated annually
calculate_state_tax uses simplified flat rates — may not match actual state tax rules

flows.name: Payroll Approve and GL Export
flows.trigger: Payroll administrator clicks Approve on HRMS_PAYROLL form after calculation

steps.action: UTL_FILE.FOPEN(GL_FEED_OUT, filename, 'W') — opens pipe-delimited output file
Writes pipe-delimited GL journal lines per payroll element

known_issues: UTL_FILE failure after STATUS='APPROVED' leaves payroll approved but no GL file — no compensating transaction
GL file must be manually picked up and imported into Oracle Financials — no automated FTP/SFTP

flows.name: Submit Leave Request
flows.trigger: Employee fills leave form and clicks Submit

steps.action: Validates: employee ACTIVE, leave type ACTIVE, minimum tenure met
Validates: start_date ≤ SYSDATE + 5 days (no more than 5 days backdating)
calculate_business_days(start_date, end_date) — BUG: observed holidays not handled
check_leave_overlap(emp_id, start_date, end_date) [PRIVATE] — raises if overlap
For ACCRUAL leave types: check balance ≥ requested days
UPDATE LEAVE_BALANCES SET PENDING_DAYS = PENDING_DAYS + total_days

known_issues: calculate_business_days does not account for observed holidays (e.g. observed Monday when holiday falls on Sunday)
VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY AVAILABLE formula omits PENDING days — potential double-booking if employee checks balance via view

flows.name: Approve Leave Request
flows.trigger: Manager approves leave request (via HRMS_LEAVE form or pending approvals view)

steps.action: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUESTS SET STATUS='APPROVED', APPROVED_BY, APPROVED_DATE
UPDATE LEAVE_BALANCES SET PENDING_DAYS = PENDING_DAYS - total_days, USED_DAYS = USED_DAYS + total_days

flows.name: Performance Review Cycle
flows.trigger: HR admin creates review cycle, opens it, bulk generates reviews

steps.action: generate_reviews_for_cycle(p_cycle_id) — loops all ACTIVE employees with MANAGER_EMP_ID
Employee submits self-assessment: submit_self_assessment → STATUS='MANAGER_REVIEW', notifies reviewer
Manager submits review: submit_manager_review → applies rating label CASE, STATUS='COMPLETED', notifies employee
Employee acknowledges: acknowledge_review → STATUS='ACKNOWLEDGED', records ACK_DATE

known_issues: Rating labels are hard-coded in CASE expression — cannot be updated without code change
generate_reviews_for_cycle swallows DUP_VAL_ON_INDEX silently (idempotent but opaque)

flows.name: Notification Queue Dispatch (Background)

steps.action: SELECT top 50 PENDING EMAIL notifications ordered by priority, created_date
FOR EACH notification: UTL_SMTP.OPEN_CONNECTION(smtp.internal.company.com, 25) — NEW connection per email

known_issues: New TCP/SMTP connection opened per email — no connection pooling — inefficient for large batches
SMTP on port 25, no TLS/STARTTLS encryption
SMTP config (host, port, from address) hard-coded as package constants — requires recompile to change

flows.name: Monthly Leave Accrual (Background)
flows.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER fires PKG_LEAVE.run_monthly_accrual on 1st of month

steps.action: Iterates all ACTIVE employees with accrual-type leave balances
Calculates accrual amount per leave type accrual rule

known_issues: Partial COMMIT every 100 rows — failure mid-batch results in partial accrual state
expire_carryover procedure has documented bug: double-subtracts if run twice on same day
